name: postdeploy-analytics

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --var ENVIRONMENT:development --var APP_ORIGIN:http://127.0.0.1:8787
scripts.build: esbuild frontend/auth.ts frontend/marketing.ts frontend/organisations.ts frontend/privacy.ts frontend/goals.ts frontend/insights.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outdir=demo/js && node worker/scripts/build-notices.mjs

description: Self-hosted web analytics for Cloudflare Workers and D1

DB.description: Your private analytics database. Cloudflare provisions it and the deploy command applies migrations using this binding.

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: Generate a random setup secret of at least 32 characters, for example `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it private; use it once at `/auth`, then remove it after creating the owner.

APP_ORIGIN.description: The exact final HTTPS origin of your own Worker, such as `https://postdeploy-team.your-subdomain.workers.dev`, without a path or trailing slash. Set this to your own origin, never analytics.postdeploy.dev. Authentication fails closed until it matches.
